note: Placeholder programmer art for the industrial / shaft / street / machine levels, drawn by tools/blocks_themed.py; shapes follow scene mockups that are not in the repository.

furnace-drum.note: horizontal teal drum with rust patches, rust bands every 32 px, glowing amber grille window, hazard base

pipe-outlet.note: large teal pipe mouth with a bolted rust flange out of a riveted wall, dirty water pouring down

valve-wheel.note: rust handwheel with six spokes on a stem over a rust pipe, steam behind

pipe-large-riveted.note: 56 px riveted rusty steel pipe (rows 4-59) with bolted flange bands every 32 px

lamp-strip-v.note: vertical shaft rail with two amber lamp segments per tile and dark gaps, side rails

lift-cage.note: lift car: cable, roof beam, steel posts, amber-lit windows behind bars, hazard band, floor

lift-platform-edge.note: heavy platform edge: deck top, wide hazard stripe band, riveted beam, amber underside lamps, struts

cable-spool.note: big cable drum with wound cable ridges and end flanges in a steel frame

girder-rust-v.note: rusty vertical lattice tower: two riveted posts with X bracing and a centre plate

bridge-deck.note: bridge deck: concrete top slab, deep riveted girder with stiffeners, red marker lamps underneath

bridge-pier.note: concrete pier column with bolted steel bands every 32 px and a red lamp on its side

jersey-barrier.note: run of concrete road barriers with amber / dark stripes, wet top, joints every 32 px, wet street

barrier-red-white.note: concrete barrier blocks with red and white diagonal stripes, chips, wet street

tank-trap.note: steel hedgehog: crossed I-beams on a wet street

banner-red.note: hanging red banner with a swallowtail bottom and a gold spread-wing emblem, rod at the top

floodlight.note: lattice mast top with a 3 x 2 lamp head, yellow light and rays

shutter-door.note: rolling shutter: horizontal slats lit amber from behind, guide posts every 32 px, header box

conveyor.note: conveyor: belt with treads, rollers every 16 px, amber riveted side rail, legs

drill-face.note: tunnel boring cutter face: three toothed rings, hub with bolts, green glow in the gaps

tread.note: crawler track: link plates top and bottom, road wheels every 32 px and return rollers

server-rack.note: rack of amber-lit cells / batteries on two shelves per tile, cables, cyan status light
